zh: 别担心，我明天会帮朋友修电脑。
old_en: I'll help your friend fix the computer tomorrow, no worries.
new_en: Don't worry, I'll help my friend fix the computer tomorrow.

zh: 明天我会去帮朋友修电脑，很快就好。
old_en: Tomorrow I'll go help your friend fix the computer, it'll be quick.
new_en: Tomorrow I'll help my friend fix the computer, it'll be quick.

zh: 下周我会把书还给你。
old_en: Next week I'll return the book to you.
new_en: Next week I'll return the book to you.

zh: 我下周会把书还给你，谢谢借我这么久。
old_en: Next week I'll return the book to you, thanks for lending it for so long.
new_en: Next week I'll return the book to you, thanks for lending it so long.

zh: 明年我会带父母去旅行。
old_en: Next year I'll take my parents on a trip.
new_en: Next year I'll take my parents on a trip.

zh: 今晚我会给你打电话。
old_en: Tonight I'll call you and we'll chat in detail.
new_en: Tonight I'll call you.

zh: 今晚我会给你打电话，我们仔细聊聊。
old_en: Tonight I'll call you to have a thorough talk.
new_en: Tonight I'll call you to have a good talk.

zh: 后天我会陪孩子去动物园，他期待很久了。
old_en: The day after tomorrow I'll take the kids to the zoo, they've been looking forward to it.
new_en: The day after tomorrow I'll take my child to the zoo, he's been looking forward to it.

zh: 后天我会请假陪孩子去动物园。
old_en: The day after tomorrow I'll take time off to take the kids to the zoo.
new_en: The day after tomorrow I'll take a day off to take my child to the zoo.

zh: 下个月我会开始锻炼身体。
old_en: Next month I'll start exercising.
new_en: Next month I'll start working out.

zh: 我下个月会开始锻炼，每周至少三次。
old_en: Next month I'll start exercising at least three times a week.
new_en: Next month I'll start exercising, at least three times a week.

zh: 下周我会把报告交上去。
old_en: Next week, I'll submit the report.
new_en: Next week I'll hand in the report.

zh: 我下周一定会把报告交上去，不会再拖了。
old_en: Next week, I'll definitely submit the report.
new_en: Next week, I'll definitely hand in the report, no more delays.

zh: 明天早上我会叫你起床。
old_en: Tomorrow morning, I'll wake you up.
new_en: Tomorrow morning, I'll wake you up.

zh: 明天早上七点我会叫你起床，别担心迟到。
old_en: Tomorrow morning at seven, I'll wake you up, don't worry about being late.
new_en: Tomorrow morning at seven, I'll wake you up, don't worry about being late.

zh: 下周末我会帮你搬家。
old_en: Next weekend, I'll help you move.
new_en: Next weekend, I'll help you move.

zh: 下周末我会去帮你搬家，需要我带什么吗？
old_en: Next weekend, I'll go help you move, do you need me to bring anything?
new_en: Next weekend, I'll help you move, do you need me to bring anything?

zh: 以后我会多陪陪家人。
old_en: I'll spend more time with my family in the future, as work isn't as important.
new_en: From now on, I'll spend more time with my family.

zh: 明年我会带父母去旅行，他们一直想去海边。
old_en: Next year, I'll take my parents on a trip to the seaside, as they've always wanted to go.
new_en: Next year, I'll take my parents to the seaside, as they've always wanted to go there.

zh: 以后我会多花时间陪家人，工作没那么重要。
old_en: I'll spend more time with my family in the future; work won't be as important.
new_en: In the future, I'll spend more time with my family; work won't be as important.
